entities.summary: Ryan Merkley is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman who plays for the Straubing Tigers of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Merkley was drafted in the first round, 21st overall, by the San Jose Sharks in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
